authorization: 用户在已知简单规则结果后明确要求继续验证：实现并比较后台最多同时1条；不含发布或推送。
pre_registration_statement: 已看过20261023-100000-p0-simple-policy-v2完整12轮结果。本协议在新cap候选主性能采集前登记，验证后续工程假设，不冒称未见过旧结果。
seed_role: 批次标识；本轮不重新随机生成内容。原请求来自seed=20261020的冻结源轨迹。

trace_source.invariant: 保留源req_id、prompt、max_tokens、temperature及类别；交互到达点保留，只修改所选后台到达时间。

original.meaning: 同一新binary关闭简单策略及后台cap，走原生选择路径但共用worker/cancel正确性修复；不是未经修改官方binary或旧批binary

simple.meaning: 同一新binary启用交互优先和5秒老化，cap关闭

capped.meaning: simple规则加后台运行上限1；老化不可绕过上限；不抢占，另一slot不作强制专用预留

aging_role: 冻结的探索工程设置，不作参数搜索，不是后台完成SLO或最大等待保证。
cache_protocol: 每轮重启同一修改后binary；默认前缀缓存；原两条固定预热单列；记录prompt_n/cache_n、实际输出与finish_reason。
timing: 客户端同一time.monotonic：计划到达至首段非空生成内容为主；TCP连接后、HTTP写前至首内容为TTFT；建连计入迟发。服务内部等待仅用其自身时钟差。
primary_metric: completed interactive total_first_ms P95; linear interpolation, paired per-run contrast

exploratory_lines.interpretation: 全部相对original及simple逐块报告的探索线。交互P95<=1000ms为本次工程假设，并非用户业务SLO、显著性、等效或G0自动通过线；复杂算法增量收益和成本仍未测。

exclusions: Retain all historical and new runs, failures and unfavorable outcomes. Pause later runs on integrity/capacity/version/50ms send-lag failure; preserve the failed run and use a new run_id after a documented repair. No performance-based deletion/replacement, threshold/load/cap search, or extension beyond18 runs.
limitations: 三策略块仅3个独立重复/场景；同批请求共享队列而不独立。只测单设备单模型固定合成轨迹与默认缓存，不含完整硬KV账本、抢占或复杂算法。达工程假设不能证明复杂算法成本不值得。
notes: Three strategies share the same newly patched binary. All18 runs collected anew as six contemporaneous three-strategy blocks; 4140 measurement requests and36 separate warmups. No pooling with the prior simple-policy cohort.
expected_persistence_mode: one async queue / serial worker-thread writes

measurement_repair.change: Per-request JSON/JSONL persistence moves from synchronous event-loop I/O to a single asynchronous queue and serial worker-thread writes; request timestamps/strategy/workload/thresholds unchanged.
measurement_repair.evidence_scope: Controlled artificial slow synchronous persistence can delay sends; not causal attribution of real-model negative policy results.
measurement_repair.required_v2_gate: 40/40 terminal closure, v2 artificial slow writes lag<=50ms and no late sends; cutoff timestamps <400ms for all8 unfinished, persistence drain separately accounted.
measurement_repair.persistence_rule: Record terminal and timestamps before persistence; wait for all request records to flush and fail the run on writer error; persistence drain excluded from model-completion denominator but reported separately.
measurement_repair.rerun_rule: Start all 12 runs anew under v2, never replace only an unfavorable simple run or pool v1 and v2 as paired repetitions.

v2_gate_observed.scope: Controlled sync persistence counterexample; does not explain actual model policy performance by itself

predecessor_batches.status_note: 12轮2760条完成且审计通过；本批选择新候选前已知，保留不拼接。

cap_evidence_schema.config: SCHED_CONFIG existing mode/background_aging_ms/preemptive fields plus max_running_background
cap_evidence_schema.launch: SCHED_CAP_LAUNCH id clientid class slot running_background_before running_background_after cap event_ms
cap_evidence_schema.release: SCHED_CAP_RELEASE same fields; exactly once for each launched slot task after cleanup
cap_evidence_schema.defer: SCHED_CAP_DEFER id clientid class running_background cap event_ms; diagnostic only
cap_evidence_schema.audit: Reconstruct all slot lifecycles using server log order, including warmups; compare active-background counts before/after, cap<=1 in capped, unique measurement launch/release, final active set empty. Never substitute client end times for server slot release.

primary_contrast.reason: 直接识别新增后台并发上限的增量收益和代价；original对比完整作为辅助。

interpretation_fields.target_with_cost_supported: Both runs complete all planned requests; candidate I P95<=1s; rate loss<=5%; B completion P95 increase<=20%. Does not establish useful improvement.
interpretation_fields.candidate_meets_all_exploratory_lines: target_with_cost_supported AND I P95 improvement>=100ms AND>=15%; no statistical or general-worth claim.
interpretation_fields.adding_cap_meets_all_exploratory_lines: Same strict flag only when candidate=capped; primary comparison is simple to capped.

development_amendments.phase: before any background-cap main performance collection

shared_backend_repair.problem: A deterministic yielding-callback barrier reproduced a pre-existing worker/cancel window: a target selected before a cancellation could later be launched after CANCEL processing.
shared_backend_repair.change: After removing and erasing a CANCEL task from the selected queue entry, repeat pending-task cleanup while holding the queue mutex before invoking its callback.
shared_backend_repair.interpretation: All three strategies use the same newly repaired binary; original means native selection path with shared correctness fixes, not an untouched official binary or exact historical simple-v2 binary.

changes: If n>1 background is rejected or launch_slot_with_task fails before successful launch on a real idle slot, retry eligible deferred work without inventing release credit.
After unmatched active cancellation removes a promoted pending request, retry eligible deferred work on actual idle slots; preserve the normal release callback when an active slot was released.

development_amendments.preservation: All prior build/unit versions, patches and counterexamples remain as separate evidence. Final unit and real-engine gate must pass on the same final source and runtime before finalized_at is recorded and before performance collection. No policy threshold, workload, comparison order, or interpretation line changed.

known_cancellation_boundary.cap1_scope: Only capped mode retries eligible deferred work on real idle slots after unmatched-active CANCEL; this fix is not generalized to cap0.
known_cancellation_boundary.cap0_inherited_limit: A very narrow deferred-promotion-then-prelaunch-cancel path can leave other deferred work waiting when no active release or later wakeup occurs; original/simple keep this inherited boundary.
known_cancellation_boundary.main_matrix_scope: Legal text n=1 requests only; no fault/cancel injection in main18. Separate correctness probes do not establish universal liveness.
known_cancellation_boundary.outcome_rule: Retain any noncompleted outcome and review the boundary/service recovery; never infer overall improvement or engineering adequacy from completed-sample P95 alone.
known_cancellation_boundary.source_status: v4 original9+new19 assertions pass; finalization is recorded by root only after real-engine gates.

client_deadline_scope: Local timeout closes the client connection; server cancellation is asynchronous and no server absolute deadline is propagated. Real probes record possible launch, actual release and recovery; deterministic queue-CANCEL barrier checks no relaunch after cancellation has reached the queue. Failed preflight fixture attempts remain separate; main workload and thresholds unchanged.

preflight_evidence.note: Both failures were probe-fixture assumptions or timing, preserved; new engine v4 unchanged between real probes.
